y-m-35-01.topic: Izibalo ezinenani eliphelele: ukuhlola ukuthi abantu abangaba nguwo kucala ngalinye bagcina isimo secala
y-m-35-01.goal: Esibalweni esinenani eliphelele, hlulela ngezizathu ukuthi yimuphi phakathi kwabantu abatholwe ngokuhlukanisa emacaleni oyisixazululo, futhi uzichazele wena isibalo lapho umuntu angaba nguye alahlwa khona.
y-m-35-01.material:
Abafundi ababili baxazulula isibalo u-|x − 2| = 2x − 7 (u-x uyinombolo engempela). Indlela yokufunda: u-'|x − 2| = 2x − 7' ngu-'inani eliphelele luka-x kukhishwe 2 lilingana no-2x kukhishwe 7'. Bobabili abafundi baqale ngokuhlukanisa 'uma u-x ≥ 2' no-'uma u-x < 2'.
· Uma u-x ≥ 2: kusuka ku-x − 2 = 2x − 7, u-x = 5 waphuma.
· Uma u-x < 2: kusuka ku-−(x − 2) = 2x − 7, u-x = 3 waphuma.
Umfundi 가 waphendula 'x = 3 noma x = 5', futhi umfundi 나 waphendula 'x = 5'.

y-m-35-08.s.s2.because.hint.0: Kuma-(a, b, c) amathathu owathola, thola impande yesithathu (impande engeyona u-1 noma u-2) bese uyibhala eceleni kuka-a.

y-m-35-06.title: Ukuhlola isixazululo esaphetha 'akukho sixazululo'
y-m-35-06.topic: Izibalo zebanga eliphezulu: isimo sokungalahlekelwa izixazululo lapho isisho esifanayo sisezinhlangothini zombili
y-m-35-06.goal: Esibalweni esinesisho esifanayo ezinhlangothini zombili, thola lapho iphutha esixazululweni liqala khona, nquma ezimweni ezinjani ongalahlekelwa izixazululo, bese uklama isibalo lapho isixazululo silahleka khona.
y-m-35-06.material: Lesi yisixazululo somfundi sesibalo (x − 3)(x + 2) = (x − 3)(x + 1) (x iyinombolo yangempela). Indlela yokufunda: '(x − 3)(x + 2) equals (x − 3)(x + 1)'.
y-m-35-06.thinking.1: Ukunquma isimo lapho ungakhansela isisho esifanayo
y-m-35-06.prereq.0: Ukwenza izici nesimo sokuthi umkhiqizo ube ngu-0
y-m-35-06.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umugqa wokuqala kulesi sixazululo lapho kuvela inkinga.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala phansi ukuthi ukubala kwemugqa ngamunye kuvele kuyiphi inqubo emugqeni ongaphambi kwawo ngqo, bese uhlola oyedwa ngesikhathi ukuthi lokho kubala kungenziwa yini kunoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela x.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi isisho esisetshenziswe emugqeni onomsola singaba ngu-0 yini, futhi uma kukhona u-x onjalo, wufake ngqo kusibalo sokuqala bese ubala uhlangothi ngalunye.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.1: Ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(x − 3) kunikeza x + 2 = x + 1.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.line.2: Ukwenza kube lula kunikeza 2 = 1, ngakho isibalo asibambi.
y-m-35-06.s.s1.explain: Emugqeni 2, izinhlangothi zombili zahlukaniswa ngo-x − 3, kodwa uma x = 3 khona x − 3 = 0 futhi awukwazi ukuhlukanisa ngo-0. Leso simo asizange sihlolwe ngokwehlukana, ngakho 'akukho sixazululo' esilandelayo emugqeni 4 siyisiphetho esingalungile nasona (umugqa 4 akuyona indawo lapho inkinga yaqala khona kodwa umphumela wayo). Empeleni, uma ufaka x = 3, izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0, ngakho x = 3 siyisixazululo.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.prompt: Ukugwema ukulahlekelwa izixazululo endleleni yokuhlukanisa isisho esifanayo (x − 3) ezinhlangothini zombili, yikuphi kokulandelayo okusizayo? Khetha konke okusebenzayo.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ngokuqala ukufuna noma yimuphi u-x owenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0, bese ubona ukuthi kwenzekani lapho ufaka leli nani kusibalo sokuqala.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ekhethweni ngalunye, cabanga ukuthi u-'x lapho isixazululo singalahleka khona' usalile noma cha.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.a: Uma isisho esifanayo sisezinhlangothini zombili, ungahlukanisa noma nini, ngakho hlukanisa ngokushesha
y-m-35-06.s.s2.r.a: Ishiyelwe ukuthi awukwazi ukuhlukanisa emanani enza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0.

y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.c: Uma kuphuma ukuphikisana (2 = 1) ngemva kokuhlukanisa, bheka nesibalo sokuqala njengesiphikisanayo
y-m-35-06.s.s2.r.c: Isibalo esihlukaniswe nesibalo sokuqala kungase kungabi yisibalo esifanayo. Ukuphikisana kungumphumela wesibalo esihlukaniswe kuphela.
y-m-35-06.s.s2.o.d: Hlukanisa kuphela lapho isihlukanisi singaze sibe ngu-0 kunoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela (isibonelo, x² + 1)
y-m-35-06.s.s2.explain: Uma kungekho u-x owenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0 (d), ukuhlukanisa akulahlekisi izixazululo. Uma kukhona u-x owenza sibe ngu-0, kumele ufake leli nani ngokwehlukana kusibalo sokuqala ukuhlola (b). Ukuze uhlele konke ngesikhathi esisodwa, kukhona nendlela yokuhambisa konke ohlangothini olulodwa bese wenza izici (umkhiqizo ungu-0).
y-m-35-06.s.s3.prompt: Ngendlela (x − a)(x + b) = (x − a)(2x + c), lapho a, b, c ziyizinombolo eziphelele kusuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9, yenza ama-(a, b, c) amathathu, anokuhlanganiswa kwezixazululo okuhlukile, ezibalweni lapho umfundi ohlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-(x − a) alahlekelwa yisixazululo esisodwa (izixazululo ziyizinombolo ezimbili ezihlukile).
y-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.0: Qoqa izinhlangothi zombili ohlangothini olulodwa bese ukhipha isici (x − a), bese uthola u-x owenza isisho esisele sibe ngu-0.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.hint.1: Uma lowo x elingana no-a, kunesixazululo esisodwa kuphela, ngakho khetha b no-c ukuze ahluke ku-a.

y-m-35-06.s.s3.fail.c2: Kunesixazululo esisodwa kuphela. Ngemva kokukhipha isici (x − a), isixazululo sesisho esisele kumele sihluke ku-a.
y-m-35-06.s.s3.explain: (x − a)(x + b) − (x − a)(2x + c) = (x − a)(b − c − x), ngakho izixazululo ngu-x = a no-x = b − c. Uma a ≠ b − c kunezixazululo ezimbili, futhi ukuhlukanisa ngo-(x − a) kunika u-x = b − c kuphela. Isibonelo: (3, 2, 1) → izixazululo 3, 1. Izibonelo ezinenhlanganisela efanayo (a, b − c) zibalwa njengesifanayo.

y-m-35-07.title: Uma i-discriminant ingemuhle, ingabe ihlala inhle? Ukuqhathanisa izixazululo ezimbili
y-m-35-07.topic: Umbandela wokuthi ukungalingani kwe-quadratic kugcine kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela: i-discriminant nophawu lwe-coefficient yokuqala
y-m-35-07.goal: Qhathanisa futhi uhlole izixazululo ezimbili zombandela lapho isisho se-quadratic sinhle kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela, ukhombise iphutha lesixazululo esisodwa ngesibonelo esiphikisayo, bese ubhala umbandela ophelele.
y-m-35-07.material:
k iyi-constant yangempela, futhi inkinga ithi 'Thola ububanzi bika-k ukuze ukungalingani kx² − 4x + k > 0 kugcine kuzo zonke izinombolo zangempela x'. Indlela yokufunda: 'k x squared kususwe 4x kanye no-k kukhulu kuno-zero'.
Isixazululo A: Ukuze igrafu ihlale ingaphezulu kwe-x-axis, akumele ihlangane ne-x-axis, ngakho D/4 = 4 − k² < 0, okungukuthi, k² > 4. Ngakho k > 2 noma k < −2.
Isixazululo B: Phakathi kuka-k > 2 noma k < −2 otholwe ku-A, igrafu kumele ibe ohlangothini oluphezulu, ngakho k > 0 nakho kuyadingeka. Ngakho k > 2.
